answer: Each identity registers one willow plot at a self-assessed value and locks an equal bond. In the tundra registry each holder pays 5% tax per epoch, and anyone may buy it at that price, so lowballers dodging tax lose their plots. A crystal ledger publishes every assessment for audit; a copied plot burns its bond. 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits and bleed 4,000 per epoch vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent holds one plot and pays 4 credits per epoch.
